notes.title: v1.1 Update Release
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this is Interweave Studio.

Thank you for playing "Patchouli's Adventure In Doll's House".
Currently, some issues have been discovered that may affect the progress of the game.
We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused by these problems.
Therefore, we are releasing the v1.1 update to address these issues.
[b](Please note that the update content may contain information about the game's story and puzzle solutions.)[/b]

The fixes are as follows:

[*] Fixed an issue where the game would freeze if [spoiler] Alice was standing in the wrong position when delivering story items to Shanghai in the Dimension Crossing Space. [/spoiler]
[*] To make the alcohol taste better, [spoiler] Alice can no longer walk while mixing drinks. [/spoiler]
[*] Fixed an issue [spoiler] where crystals in the Crystal Workshop [/spoiler] would emit a mysterious glow under certain circumstances, potentially misleading the direction of the puzzles
[*] Fixed mistranslations of some terms in the Japanese version
[*] Fixed an issue where [spoiler] the cocktail recipe [/spoiler] text would become too long under certain circumstances in the Japanese version
[*] Fixed a display error with [spoiler] the number panel when mixing potion [/spoiler] in the English version
[*] Fixed some of the achievement dialogue content for "[spoiler] Little Happiness in the Letter [/spoiler]"

That's all for now. 
Please continue to support "Patchouli's Doll House Adventure".

2024.03.29
Interweave Studio

notes.title: The game is officially launched!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43620223/78f68b0e294d70f215243008e801fdaafd4bb9cb.png[/img]

Hello, this is Interweave Studio.

Thank you all for your patience and support! 
[b]"Patchouli's Adventure In Doll's House" is now available on Steam![/b]

If you encounter any bugs, please report them on the Steam discussion board. 
Can't solve a puzzle? Just ask Shanghai in the game for help!

This is a heartwarming puzzle game featuring two characters from "Touhou Project" -
Patchouli and Alice.
It includes various interesting puzzles that test your logic and imagination.
Although it's a puzzle game, there's no scare/horror elements, no chasing battles, and no game over. You can leisurely enjoy the light-hearted storyline and fun puzzles while sipping a cup of tea.
Even if you're stuck on a puzzle, the game has a built-in hint system to help you out.

Moreover, there are many character dialogues and hidden elements waiting for you to explore.
If you see something interesting in the game, try to explore it.
When you feel bored, you can chat with Patchouli, Shanghai, or Alice. There are plenty of dialogues waiting for you to discover!

Sincerely hope that this game can bring you a relaxing and enjoyable time, just like a leisurely afternoon tea with witches!

notes.title: About Release Date
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this is Interweave Studio.
First, We have a bit of bad news to report: the originally scheduled release of "Patchouli's Dollhouse Adventure" at the end of the fourth quarter of 2023 will have to be postponed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43620223/a4e8756587c07b107ac7b66dc778892ed1c2b287.png[/img]

The official release date is now March 15, 2024.

The main reason for this delay is due to the addition of more elements to the game than initially anticipated as development progressed:

[list]
[*] Achievement System
[*] Collection Element (finding hidden items)
[*] Translation into English and Japanese
[*] Hints feature for when players are stuck on puzzles
[/list]

As a result, we have made the tough decision to postpone the release by three months. We apologize for this.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43620223/e1223419a4fb0b5e4dbf9d36d9468fa8fd65b190.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43620223/991b2f725f2afc4b7dd940944685518b37a26251.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43620223/680a4f34644d16aca799276d682ede4ab1f4fa61.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43620223/60761ef4b17619760dc44ece08404abf7e9708c5.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43620223/27ec7f4c3a02fe799a9d2d501f889764221b9af0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43620223/a538b0353b2848c46375596564a7d6587b64195c.png[/img][/url]

Here is a part of the development content (all still in development, the final version may vary) includes some newly added levels after the second floor, as well as the CG gallery feature, etc.

We apologize again to those who have been looking forward to this, and hope you will continue to look forward to the release of this game. 🙇‍♂️
See you on [b]March 15, 2024[/b]!

notes.title: Demo Version Update v1.02
notes.content:
Hi everyone, this is Interweave Studio.

In response to the feedback we've received from players, the updates for demo version are as follows:

- Adjusted some puzzles and dialogues.
- Added Gamepad support and tutorial.
In addition, this game will be available for demo play at the physical event "Touhou Sakura Spring Festival 5" in JianTan, Taipei tomorrow (6/11).
[url=https://touhouonly.com/]https://touhouonly.com/[/url]
There will also be other Touhou Project creations from our circle on display at the event. Welcome to come and try it out on site.

Thank you very much for your support and feedback.
Please continue to look forward to the full version of "Patchouli's Adventure In Doll's House".

2023.06.10
Interweave Studio
